hero.headline: DTF Film Rolls & Sheets
hero.subheadline: Water Bourne Coating Technology — Made in India, Trusted Worldwide
hero.body: Ultranex DTF Films are engineered for consistent, high-quality Direct-to-Film printing. Available in three grades — Ultra, Prime1, and Premium — each formulated for specific production needs. Instant hot peel, oil-free transfers, vibrant colour output, and trouble-free powder application in every roll.

products.name: DTF Ultra
products.tagline: Single Matte · Instant Hot Peel · Oil Free
products.description: Single matte DTF film with 1-side printable matte coating and back-side gloss antistatic coating. Ideal for standard DTF workflows requiring a satin-matte finish with no second press required.
highlights: Instant Hot Peel — no second press needed
Single matte front, gloss antistatic back

products.name: DTF Prime1
products.tagline: Double Matte · Extra Traction · No Roll Sticking
products.description: Double matte DTF film with 1-side printable matte coating and back-side matte antistatic coating for extra traction, no powder sticking, and printed roll sticking resistance. Thicker coating for demanding production runs.
highlights: Double matte — front printable + back matte antistatic
No powder sticking on back side

products.name: DTF Premium
products.tagline: Double Matte · Structured Back · Maximum Stability
products.description: Double matte DTF film with 1-side printable matte coating and back-side structured matte antistatic coating. The structured back provides maximum traction and roll stability for automated and high-volume production lines.
highlights: Maximum roll stability for automated lines
No powder sticking, no roll sticking
Soft feel hand feel on transfers

printingGuidelines.headline: Guidelines for Printing & Transfer
steps: Wear gloves while handling rolls or sheets to avoid surface damage. Repack rolls in moisture-proof bags after use.
Keep the rubber gripper clean and maintain low unwinding tension on the printing machine for better registration.
Preheat the printed film if required before powder application.
Powder shaker drying: set temperature 100°C to 140°C (212°F to 284°F) for 4–7 minutes. Preliminary temperature testing is recommended.
Cool the film before winding to avoid sticking.
Transfer settings: 125°C to 180°C (257°F to 356°F) for 4–15 seconds at 2–4 bar pneumatic pressure. Parameters vary by fabric and machine.
For instant hot peel: ensure equal temperature and pressure at all corners. One orientation trial with waste cloth is recommended. Pneumatic machines are preferred.
printingGuidelines.note: "Oil Free" / Moisture Free DTF transfers require sufficient drying. Ultranex DTF Film is formulated to maximise moisture evaporation from the coating after printing.

items.question: What is the difference between Ultra, Prime1, and Premium?
items.answer: Ultra (F86SM1) is a single matte film with a gloss antistatic back — best for standard workflows. Prime1 (F90SM2) is double matte with a thicker 15 µ coating and matte antistatic back for extra traction. Premium (F86SM2) is double matte with a structured matte antistatic back for maximum roll stability in automated production lines.

items.question: What sizes are available?
items.answer: All grades are available in 1200 mm, 900 mm, 800 mm, 600 mm, and 300 mm widths in 100 m rolls. Sheets are available on customer request. Custom widths and lengths are also available — contact us with your requirements.

items.question: What peel types are supported?
items.answer: All Ultranex DTF grades support Hot, Warm, and Cold Peel, giving you flexibility to match your workflow and fabric type.

items.question: What fabrics can DTF film be used on?
items.answer: Ultranex DTF Film works on cotton, polyester, blends, spandex, denim, canvas, and leather — on both light and dark coloured fabrics.
